cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.0)
project(DSALogicLibrary)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 26)

find_package(Java REQUIRED)
set(JAVA_AWT_LIBRARY "NotNeeded")
set(JAVA_JVM_LIBRARY "NotNeeded")
find_package(JNI REQUIRED)

# Add source files
set(SOURCE_FILES library.cpp library.h)

# Build the "SHARED" library (.dll)
add_library(DSALogicLibrary SHARED ${SOURCE_FILES})

# --- This config section was generated by GEMINI ---
# (side note: had to switch to MinGW compiler instead of Cygwin to work)

# 1. Strip the "lib" prefix so the file is just "MyJniLibrary.dll"
set_target_properties(DSALogicLibrary PROPERTIES PREFIX "")
# 2. Package all MinGW system files directly inside your DLL
if(MINGW)
    target_link_options(DSALogicLibrary PRIVATE "-static-libgcc" "-static-libstdc++" "-static")
endif()
#-------------------------------------------

# Include JNI header paths so C++ can find jni.h
target_include_directories(DSALogicLibrary
        PRIVATE
        ${JNI_INCLUDE_DIRS}
)
